en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Aban, from Al Fuzayl, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who claims the Imamate and he isn’t from its rightful ones, so he is an Infidel’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from ‘Abdallah ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa fromAli ibn al-Hakam fromAban from al-Fudayl from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.
“Whoever would claim to be the Imam and in fact he would not be the Imam he would be a unbeliever.”
